blocking_findings.summary: Native Claude approval rejects the documented ExitPlanMode response (factory/scripts/forge_cli/approval.py:203): When a user approves a plan through Claude's `ExitPlanMode`, the documented output contains `plan`, `isAgent`, and optional plan-state fields—not a `status` value of `success`, `succeeded`, or `completed` ([official schema](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/typescript)).
blocking_findings.title: Native Claude approval rejects the documented ExitPlanMode response

blocking_findings.summary: Claude context-file grills cannot be recorded (factory/scripts/forge_cli/delegate.py:1804): Trigger: run a Claude cold grill with `--context-file`.
blocking_findings.title: Claude context-file grills cannot be recorded

blocking_findings.summary: Bind the grouped-review runner into reviewed-meaning identity (factory/scripts/forge_cli/review.py:2025): When a vendored client already has a clean selected generation and an upgrade changes `forge_cli/review_groups.py`, this line still computes the reusable identity through `reviewed_meaning_identity`, whose instruction inventory at `stages.py:1029-1034` hashes `review.py` and `review_brief.py` but not the grouped runner that controls scope partitioning, retries, finding routing, and verdict merging.
blocking_findings.title: Bind the grouped-review runner into reviewed-meaning identity

blocking_findings.summary: Do not discard substantive nested evidence fields (factory/scripts/forge_cli/stages.py:1011): When an allowed automated-report extension contains a nested field named `commit`, `at`, or another bookkeeping-like name (for example, a security scan's source commit), this recursive filter removes that field at every depth.
blocking_findings.title: Do not discard substantive nested evidence fields

blocking_findings.summary: Treat compound or transitive verification commands as non-reusable (factory/scripts/forge_cli/stages.py:1995): When a verify command starts with Python or `uv` but subsequently invokes another tool—through a shell chain or through `verify.py`'s configured FACTORY_* commands—this branch marks it reusable after identifying only the outer Python environment.
blocking_findings.title: Treat compound or transitive verification commands as non-reusable

blocking_findings.summary: Treat a failed clean-tree probe as a hard refusal (factory/scripts/forge_cli/upgrade.py:1118): When `git status --porcelain` fails—for example because the index is corrupt or unreadable—it commonly returns nonzero with empty stdout; this code tests only the captured text and therefore proceeds with the destructive upgrade as though the checkout were clean.
blocking_findings.title: Treat a failed clean-tree probe as a hard refusal

blocking_findings.summary: Bind selected-review reuse to the current grill evidence (factory/scripts/record_review_from_json.py:138): When a task is re-grilled without changing its plan or product delta, this line accepts the previous review input because `reviewed_meaning_identity()` hashes the plan, task contract, tests report, helper, and delta but omits the task grill/approval record that `review_brief.py` renders as an approved review input.
blocking_findings.title: Bind selected-review reuse to the current grill evidence
